item.title: [LU-20285] replaces an indirect heuristic (vui_ra_valid flag) with a direct check of the I/O type (CIT_FAULT)
item.description:
The patch replaces an indirect heuristic (vui_ra_valid flag)
with a direct check of the I/O type (CIT_FAULT),
which represents a page fault handling operation
(typically triggered by mmap'd page access).

CIT_FAULT explicitly indicates the I/O is happening
due to a page fault from a memory-mapped region,
rather than inferring from readahead validity.
item.summary: replaces an indirect heuristic (vui_ra_valid flag) with a direct check of the I/O type (CIT_FAULT)

status.description: The issue is open and ready for the assignee to start work on it.

comments.comment:
Since somebody have some questions on this change, i studied the code a little.

The old sign was initialized in cl_io_init as false 

 

  cl_io_init(env, io, io_type, obj)
      └─ coo_io_init()  // cl_object_operations
          └─ vvp_io_init(env, obj, io)  

 

and set true only in read process, the code like this.

 

static int vvp_io_read_start(const struct lu_env *env,
                               const struct cl_io_slice *ios){
      struct vvp_io *vio = cl2vvp_io(env, ios);
      struct cl_io *io = ios->cis_io;
      struct cl_object *obj = io->ci_obj;
      struct inode *inode = vvp_object_inode(obj);
      struct ll_inode_info *lli = ll_i2info(inode);
      struct file *file = vio->vui_fd->fd_file;
      loff_t pos = io->u.ci_rd.rd.crw_pos;
      size_t crw_bytes = io->u.ci_rd.rd.crw_bytes;
      size_t tot_bytes = vio->vui_tot_bytes;
      int result;
      ENTRY;
      trunc_sem_down_read(&lli->lli_trunc_sem);
      // ━━━ return 1: async read ━━━
      if (io->ci_async_readahead) {
          file_accessed(file);
          RETURN(0);  // ← vui_ra_valid remains false
      }
      // ━━━ return 2: Layout change  ━━━
      if (!can_populate_pages(env, io, inode))
          RETURN(0);  // ← vui_ra_valid remains false
      // ━━━ return 3: LRU preserve failed  ━━━
      flags = iocb_ki_flags_get(file, vio->vui_iocb);
      if (!iocb_ki_flags_check(flags, DIRECT)) {
          result = cl_io_lru_reserve(env, io, pos, crw_bytes);
          if (result)
              RETURN(result);  // ← vui_ra_valid remains false
      }
      // ━━━ erturn 4: filesize check  ━━━
      result = vvp_prep_size(env, obj, io, pos, crw_bytes, &exceed);
      if (result != 0)
          RETURN(result);  // ← vui_ra_valid remains false
      else if (exceed != 0)
          GOTO(out, result);  // ← vui_ra_valid remains false
      // ━━━ set true  ━━━
      /* initialize read-ahead window once per syscall */
      if (!vio->vui_ra_valid) {
          vio->vui_ra_valid = true;  // vui_ra_valid set true
          vio->vui_ra_start_idx = pos >> PAGE_SHIFT;
          vio->vui_ra_pages = 0;
          page_offset = pos & ~PAGE_MASK;
          if (page_offset) {
              vio->vui_ra_pages++;
              if (tot_bytes > PAGE_SIZE - page_offset)
                  tot_bytes -= (PAGE_SIZE - page_offset);
              else
                  tot_bytes = 0;
          }
          vio->vui_ra_pages += (tot_bytes + PAGE_SIZE - 1) >> PAGE_SHIFT;
          CDEBUG(D_READA, "tot %zu, ra_start %lu, ra_count %lu\n",
                 vio->vui_tot_bytes, vio->vui_ra_start_idx,
                 vio->vui_ra_pages);
      }
      // ━━━ actually  I/O (第 892 行) ━━━
      result = generic_file_read_iter(vio->vui_iocb, &iter);
      // this will cause page_fault → ll_readpage() → ll_io_read_page()
      ......
}

 

as we can see, if vio->vui_ra_valid remains false, it won't trigger ll_io_read_page(). 

This means when in ll_io_read_page(), if the sign is true, it will no doubtly comes from a REAL read.

But if the sign is false, it will comes from Not only mmap, but also a normal write with page fault.

Regarding a write as a mmap won't affect this function's correctness, because ll_io_read_page() still will grab the page, 

but it may cause more RPCs as a mmap, miscalculate the statistic info and affect the RAS policy. 

So the change is more precise.

diff --git a/lustre/llite/rw.c b/lustre/llite/rw.c
index f6836627fe..753c9613e9 100644

+++ b/lustre/llite/rw.c
@@ -1742,8 +1742,7 @@ int ll_io_read_page(const struct lu_env *env, struct cl_io *io,

        int                        rc = 0, rc2 = 0;
        bool                       uptodate;

        pgoff_t ra_start_index = 0;
